name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; descriptor accurately describes the top-level class-promotion menu loop (church/promotion service). The 'main' suffix correctly distinguishes this driver from its helpers fd2_promote_member_select_loop (the grid picker) and fd2_build_promotion_candidates_with_targets. No Ghidra address residue. No trailing-number residue. Sole caller fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeC confirms it is the town promotion-service entry.
purpose: Top-level CLASS PROMOTION menu loop for the town promotion service: builds the eligible-candidate list, prompts/picks/confirms a member, consumes the required class-change item, plays the promotion fanfare/cinematic, writes back the new job_id/portrait_id, reloads party portraits, and applies the stat gains.
logic_summary: void(void). Outer do/while(1) loop. (1) fd2_build_promotion_candidates_with_targets fills parallel candidate_chars[32]/target_classes[32] and returns the count. (2) count==0 -> load chapter type-C portrait (speaker table[4]), show 'no one is ready' dialog (FDTXT page 0x24F), wait input, slide out, return. (3) show 'promote whom?' (page 0x250), wait input(blink=1), slide out, clear keyboard. (4) fd2_promote_member_select_loop(count, candidate_chars, target_classes) -> 1 commit / -1 cancel; -1 returns. (5) reload portrait, char_idx=candidate_chars[cursor_idx], class_id=target_classes[cursor_idx], set last_action_sprite_id=char.portrait_id+1, show 'ready to become [class]?' (page 0x252), run fd2_text_dialog_typewriter_loop; loop back to top if typewriter==-1 or cursor_idx!=0 (NO chosen). (6) item consumption: class_id==0x34 (Lord direct) consumes Sword 0x5A; class_id>0x31 consumes the key item read from data_fd2_ui_per_basic_portrait_class_change_key_item_id_table[char.portrait_id]; class_id<=0x31 (0x20..0x31 tier-1 upgrade) consumes nothing. (7) BGM 0x10 fanfare, fd2_play_spell_cast_cinematic(char_idx,class_id), BGM 0x0B ambient. (8) job_id=*fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry(class_id); portrait_id=target_classes[cursor_idx]; free portrait_sprite_cache if set, reopen FDICON.B24, reset portrait_cache_count, reload every party portrait via fd2_load_portrait_to_cache(roster[7+i*0x50]), fclose. (9) fd2_execute_class_promotion_with_dialog(char_idx) (stat gains + spell unlock + HP/MP restore), clear keyboard, loop back to step 1. Frame 0x7C (__CHK). Confirmed against disasm: CMP [ESP+0x40],0x32 / JL skips consumption for class_id<=0x31; own ADD ESP,0x44 / POP EBP,EDI,ESI,EBX / RET epilogue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Returns to caller (fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_typeC) when there are no eligible candidates (early return) or the member-select grid is cancelled with ESC (sel==-1). After a successful promotion the loop restarts from step 1.

notes: Source comment block (promote.c lines 474-528) is already comprehensive, accurate, and verified line-by-line against decompile + disassembly (item-consumption thresholds 0x34/0x31, portrait reload loop roster[7+i*0x50], own epilogue). comment_verdict=keep. Ghidra plate is semantically consistent with the source (it says FDTXT 'sprite 0x24F' where source says 'page 0x24F' for FDTXT page ids -- not contradictory), so ghidra_plate_action=none, no save_program needed. params=[] (void). Constants 0x34/0x32/0x31/0x20 are promoted-class ID domain values, not address residue. No logic issues found; game logic left untouched.
